away.summary: The Seattle Kraken have shown strong offensive production early in the season, scoring 13 goals in their first three games, including two six-goal outings against Calgary. However, they were shut down by the Vegas Golden Knights in a 6-2 loss, struggling to convert chances despite generating shots and offensive zone time. The team will look to regain their offensive rhythm heading into this matchup.

home.summary: The Detroit Red Wings are getting a boost with Dylan Larkin returning to the lineup after missing the first two games due to an upper-body injury. Larkin made an impact in his debut, scoring a goal and recording an assist in a 5-3 win over Ottawa. However, Detroit remains thin at center, with Marco Kasper (week to week), J.T. Compher (day to day), and Mason Appleton (week to week) all sidelined due to injuries. The team has struggled offensively early, scoring just two goals in their first two games before Larkin's return.
